reviews.comment: He's a sweetheart but can be difficult to understand at times. If you pay attention in class and understand the material, there's no way you'll fail. He does assign homework just about every week, but they're super easy and super short. There are 2 exams, a midterm and a final, but they are basically the same as the homework. Take him!!

This class is terrible. You cannot understand the professor. When you ask him a question, all he will do is ask the class if someone else knows it and explain. He is passive-aggressive at times. The actual material for the class is not that hard, he is. The tests are worth 55% total of your overall grade, and they are way harder than the homework.

He is a nice guy... kinda, but he also is very passive-aggressive sometimes. He is hard to understand, and you feel like you are learning the same thing all semester. I would not recommend taking him.  The homework is pretty easy, and then the tests are harder, and his grading is very confusing.

He was a horrible professor. He can not speak English well, and this makes it very difficult to even learn all the material in the class. I did not pass the class by one point and he would not give extra credit, nor did he try and help me out to get a C. He has a TA who grades and makes all the homework and tests. Do not take him.

I am not a math person but this class really had a lot of homework and tests that were hard to follow and understand sometimes. Homework is a lot easier than the exams. Make sure to study hard all of the terms and understand the material in order to pass the exams.

Professor Li is a nice man but i didn't enjoy him as a professor or his class at all. I was constantly not understanding what was being taught to me and he's not very helpful. His TA grades everything and if it's not exactly the answer he wants then you get points off and too many points in my opinion. I don't recommend him at all.

Dr. Li is nice but he lectures the whole class. You have an assignment or two every class. You do lots of group work in the same group the whole semester. The homework doesn't always match the homework. He is pretty boring to listen to and takes off points for minor things. If you do ALL the work you can get an A but Dr. Li is not the best teacher.

This class was pretty easy and doable, however, the assignments were way more difficult compared to what you learn in class. Same with the exams, which makes this class difficult for no reason. There are also lots of assignments due every week, always 3 and sometimes 4 due every week.

Dr. Li is a sweet man, however, during his lectures there were times when I could not understand him, but if you have questions, you are able to email him and he will reply right away! The course is graded on 12 homework assignments, 2 exams and a final project, no extra credit. You need to actually work in this class, not an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: DO NOT take this Prof. He doesn't speak English well and is EXTREMELY hard to understand. You won't learn anything because he doesn't teach so it is very hard to pass his tests. He didn't care about technical issues with the online format during Corona, "technical problems are your problems not mine" (a direct quote) He blew my 4.0 because of this.
Really long lectures where he solely reads off the powerpoint that are posted an hour later online. Kind of hard to understand with accent. Weekly homework that doesn't take long and two tests.

The most boring lecturer I've ever had. Expects students to understand concepts but spends 20 plus minutes discussing problems that should be taught to elementary students. His TA creates and grades all homework/tests and he lectures. If you want to actually learn how to teach math for your future class, don't take him.

The most kind man you will ever meet. Dr. Li has his TA create and grade the homeworks, but he gives the lectures. He makes sure that everyone understands the material and is so friendly, you could go up to him at any time and he will answer your questions. I would take another class from him just because he was the prof. Oh and no textbook!
